eligibility: Nondeprecated referenced statements. Exactly one applicable capital ID. Unknown qualifier, calendar, incomplete reference or exact transition-day scope is excluded.
accepted_alternatives: Wrong claims cannot equal any nondeprecated object ID or any accepted label/alias, including retained historical alternatives.
split_hash: sha256(split-v1 + entity_id/P36) modulo 20: train <12, development 12..14, audit 15..19
ordering: sha256(allocation-v1 + entity_id/P36), fixed before data acquisition completes
same_name_entities: One deterministic representative per normalized subject label
truth_assignment: Alternate True/False along fixed ordering within each split; never choose with model or audit scores
wrong_capital_assignment: Hash-order real capitals by sha256(negative-v1 + group_id + object_id) per subject, then exclude all accepted alternatives. Never a fixed wrong-city marker.
required_label_counts: Exactly half True and half False in each split
audit_policy: Source integrity and visibility checked before training. No audit neural or frozen shortcut scores until development-only epoch selection finishes.
